label: CPU
description: Arm A-profile CPU 系统寄存器

registers.name: SCTLR_EL1
registers.description: 提供系统的顶层控制，包括 EL1 和 EL0 的内存系统。

fields.name: TIDCP

fields.name: SPINTMASK
fields.description: [当 FEAT_NMI 实现时] SP 中断掩码使能。 当 SCTLR_EL1.NMI 为 1 时, 控制是否 PSTATE.SP acts as an interrupt mask, and controls the value of PSTATE.ALLINT on taking 异常 到 EL1。[0b0: Does not cause PSTATE.SP to mask interrupts. PSTATE.ALLINT is set to 1 on taking 异常 到 EL1 ; 0b1: When PSTATE.SP is 1 and execution is at EL1, an IRQ or FIQ interrupt that is targeted 到 EL1 is mask]；否则为 res0

fields.name: NMI
fields.description: [当 FEAT_NMI 实现时] 不可屏蔽中断 (NMI) 使能。 [0b0: 此控制不影响中断屏蔽行为。 ; 0b1: 此控制使能以下功能：PSTATE.ALLINT 中断掩码、IRQ 和 FIQ ]；否则为 res0

fields.name: TCSO
fields.description: [当 FEAT_MTE_STORE_ONLY 实现时] 仅存储标记检查 (Tag Checking Store Only)。当 FEAT_VMTETC 实现且满足以下所有条件时，此字段有效值为 1： [0b0: 此字段不影响 Tag Checking； 0b1: Explicit Memory Read Effects generated by instructions executed in EL1 are Tag Unchecked.]；否则为 res0

fields.name: TCSO0

fields.name: EPAN
fields.description: [当 FEAT_PAN3 实现时] 增强的 Privileged Access Never (EPAN)。 When PSTATE.PAN is 1, 决定是否 an EL1 data access to a page with stage 1 EL0 instruction access permission generates a Permission fault as a result of the Privileged Access Never mechanism.。此位允许在 TLB 中缓存。 [0b0: No additional Permission faults are generated by this mechanism. ; 0b1: An EL1 data access to a page with stage 1 EL0 data access permission or stage 1 EL0 instruction acce]；否则为 res0

fields.name: EnASR

fields.description: [当 FEAT_TWED 实现时] TWE (WFE陷获) 延迟使能。使能 SCTLR_EL1.nTWE 引起的 WFE* 指令的可配置延迟陷获。 [0b0: 陷获延迟为 IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED。 ; 0b1: 陷获延迟由 at least the number of cycles defined in SCTLR_EL1.TWEDEL.]；否则为 res0

fields.name: nTWE
fields.description: 将 EL0 (两种执行状态) 对 WFE 指令的执行陷获到 EL1，或当 EL2 已实现且启用且 HCR_EL2.TGE=1 时陷获到 EL2，异常 EC 值为 0x01。 当 FEAT_WFxT 实现时，此陷获也适用于 WFET 指令。 In AArch32 state, the attempted execution of a conditional WFE instruction is only trapped if the instruction passes its condition code check.
